notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup (trial used all free credits)

Summary: SMB CX startup building a midsize conversational support product. Signed up via hosted API free credits in Jan, ran basic chat POC (small bot) and hit cost ceiling. Wants to continue using hosted API — likes low friction + SDKs. High sensitivity to per-token cost; estimates 200-300 monthly active agents initially, bursty support volume during business hours.

Key requirements / asks:
- Use case: multi-turn support bot + end-user summarization of tickets; initial focus on chat and summarization prompts.
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for single-turn replies, pref < 200ms for short messages.
- Throughput: average ~30-60 reqs/min, peaks ~200 reqs/min during product launches.
- Model prefs: open to small Llama-family or similar open models; willing to try Redwood-verified variants if cost helps.
- Routing/fallback: want simple fallback to cheaper model when burst hits quota.
- Security: SOC2 posture is important; will need audit logs and basic retention controls (30–90 days).

Procurement conversation (primary blocker):
- They started on credit card but need clarity: can they switch to invoice for monthly billing if ARR grows? Wants thresholds for invoice eligibility (what commit and net-30 terms).
- Asked about startup discount / credits extension — they are early-stage YC-ish, asked if Redwood has startup program or one-off credit extension.
- Free credits ran out last week; POC stalled because finance won't authorize card charges until discount/invoice path clarified.
